Sophie (FinOps): Heads up: our reconcile flagged ~37 Stripe events that created zero-line invoices in NetSuite from last night's window (23:45-00:30 UTC). Totals are missing line items so revenue missing.

Diego (Integrations): Which webhook IDs? Any common pattern?

Sophie (FinOps): Example: wh_1Lm9xZzz999. The Stripe payload in the DLQ shows "lines": [] even though Stripe dashboard shows charge with items.

ops-bot: Alert: invoice_count_anomaly(2026-03-19): net_revenue_delta = -$18,432, triggered at 2026-03-19T01:12:05Z

Lena (Billing-Eng): That smells like our proxy or the edge truncating payloads; maybe header size or body stream cut off. Do we have raw bytes?

Diego (Integrations): Pulled raw DLQ payload: 
```
POST /integrations/stripe/webhook-proxy
Content-Length: 512
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
{\n  "id": "evt_1Lm9w...",\n  "data": {"object": {"id": "in_1Lm9v...", "amount": 1843200, "lines": [\n    {"id": "li_1", "sku": "SUB_PRO", "qty": 1},\n    {"id": "li_2", "sku": "ADD_ON_X", "qty": 2},\n    // truncated at ~400 bytes
```
Payload ends abruptly with no closing brackets.

Sophie (FinOps): But Stripe console replay shows a full payload for that event. So the loss is in our pipeline.

Diego (Integrations): Our proxy logs show the request body read succeeded then upstream POST to netsuite-worker failed with 502 but we still acked. I wonder if our HTTP client uses a streaming buffer with a max size of 4096 and we hit it.

Lena (Billing-Eng): If NetSuite gets a partial JSON it's parsed and sanitized to empty 'lines' array in our transform layer. That would explain zero-line invoices.

Marta (Finance Ops): Operational impact: those invoices went through with just an invoice header — no lines, not present on revenue reports. Need backfill before close. What's the rollback/risky paths?

Diego (Integrations): Immediate mitigations: 1) stop auto-ack in proxy for stripe webhooks and switch to retry mode so we don't lose payloads; 2) add size metrics and a check for Content-Length vs body.len; 3) patch HTTP client to stream larger bodies or buffer to disk for >4KB.

Lena (Billing-Eng): For backfill: replay Stripe events from stripe.replay for the window, but ensure our replay hits the patched proxy (or skip proxy and hit netsuite worker directly with a replay tool). We'll need dedupe.

Diego (Integrations): I can put together a hotfix that removes the 4KB in-memory cap and writes oversize bodies to /tmp before posting upstream. Quick code snippet: 
```
# proxy/handler.py
body = request.get_data()\nif len(body) > 4096:\n  with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False) as f:\n    f.write(body)\n  upstream_post(open(f.name, 'rb'))\nelse:\n  upstream_post(io.BytesIO(body))
```

Sophie (FinOps): Sounds reasonable. Can we also add a check that compares Content-Length header to actual read bytes and alert if mismatch?

Diego (Integrations): Yes. I'll add metric stripe.payload_mismatch.count and alert > 1 in 1h to #finance-incidents.

Lena (Billing-Eng): Backfill plan (approved):
1) deploy hotfix to staging, run replay for 23:45-00:30 on staging to validate lines preserved
2) deploy to prod during maintenance window 08:30 PST
3) run replay with --dedupe against netsuite-worker direct endpoint: 
```
./tools/replay_stripe.py --since 2026-03-19T23:45:00Z --until 2026-03-20T00:30:00Z --target netsuite-direct --dedupe --commit
```
4) confirm invoices match Stripe and update reconciliation file.

Marta (Finance Ops): Please flag which invoices are affected; we'll hold downstream recognition until confirmed. Also need a timeline so accounting can adjust forecasting.

Diego (Integrations): Estimate: staging validation 1h, prod deploy + smoke 30m, replay run ~15-45m depending on backpressure. Total ~2.5h incl runbook prep.

Sophie (FinOps): OK schedule for deploy at 08:30 PST. Please include rollback (revert proxy and run a dry-run replay to ensure no duplicates).

Lena (Billing-Eng): Note: netsuite-worker will reject duplicates based on event.id idempotency key, but the direct target must preserve original event.id header. Diego, ensure the replay tool preserves X-Stripe-Event and any signature headers we need for validation.

Diego (Integrations): Will do. Also adding integration test that replays a long 'lines' payload through the proxy to netsuite-worker asserting lines.count == 2.

ops-bot: Runbook created: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/stripe-truncation-2026-03-19

Marta (Finance Ops): Thanks. I'll hold any manual journal entries until you confirm backfill success. Keep this thread updated.

Sophie (FinOps): TY. If you hit any unexpected duplicates, post to #release-war-room immediately. :pray:
